INSERT INTO outfit_record (id, record_date, photo_path, filter_type, memo, is_main, item_tags, look_category, location, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{recordDate}, #{photoPath}, #{filterType}, #{memo}, #{isMain}, #{itemTags}, #{lookCategory}, #{location}, now())

mapper.update: UPDATE outfit_record SET is_main = 0 WHERE record_date = #{recordDate}

UPDATE outfit_record SET like_count = like_count + CASE WHEN #{liked} = 1 AND is_liked = 0 THEN 1 WHEN #{liked} = 0 AND is_liked = 1 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END, is_liked = #{liked} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE outfit_record SET is_saved = #{saved} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outfit_record WHERE is_saved = 1 ORDER BY record_date DESC, id DESC
